description.en:
Closes the stand talk scene opened by StartStandEvent: it fades the camera's DepthLevel back to the saved value and the depth range from 1.5 to 1.0 over _frm frames, removes the blur (CMND_BOKE_DELETE(0.0, 7.0)), waits, restores the pause bits and clears the talking characters (CMND_RESET_TALK_CHARA).
Calling it when no stand scene is open only prints a debug message.
Length of the transition in frames.

examples.case: Closing the stand scene (real usage, from ev42010450.nut)
